## Notes

Criterion 1 is half built since 2026-11-01. #1146 (8a9fb51, `Reviewed by:` a second session, deploy-health green) freezes a Page's home town at first publish as `groups.place_url_slug`, taken from the anchor Location's place (migration 20261101120000; the column comment calls it "the Page's home town in its address"). That is 1a. The fallback to the owner's home town for a Page with no Location (1b) is not built: such a Page gets no home town. No test claims either half. Criteria 2 to 5 are untouched: no give-back field, column or setting exists in src, scripts, supabase or tests (grep `give_back`, `giveBack`, `give-back` finds nothing) [V]. No `uat` Issue; no smoke run covers the address.

The interim badge from #875 (2026-10-16, `review-skipped`, deploy-health green on 169a686) is unchanged: "Claimed local owner" shows whenever the owner has made the Locally Owned claim, with no town test, on Don's words that day (local "will be solely determined by if money comes back to where it was generated"; for now, "Yes claim"). It is not criterion 3. The scenario's "Not this" still says no badge in beta (cut 2026-10-06); `sync-roadmap` should record the 2026-10-16 call.

No new Issue: #700 (1, 2, 5) and #701 (3, 4) are open, deferred, no milestone (unplanned, scenario has no `gates:`). I commented on #700 with the built half.
